data.exact_reserve_text: The change in claims outstanding includes the impact of release of net reserves for claims incurred on the prior years of GBP 15.9m (2023: strengthening of GBP 80.4m). These net reserve movements are stated net of the protection provided by the LPT.

prior_year_events.event_name: Enstar ground-up loss portfolio transfer (LPT) / adverse development cover
prior_year_events.impact_description: Closed a ground-up LPT in Q2 2022 which provides $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves as at the effective date and transfers responsibility and expense of handling 2019 and prior gross claims to Enstar; this protection reduced net reserve deterioration on 2019 and prior years.

Exposures reviewed (aviation reinsurance, credit and political risks and international crisis management); reasonable provision for identified claims made; further claims possible but not expected to be material to the Syndicate to date.

named_events.loss_description: Provides $450m adverse development cover on Group reserves of $3.12bn at the effective date; transfers handling of 2019 and prior gross claims to Enstar.
Exposures identified and reviewed; reasonable provision for all claims identified to date have been made; further claims possible.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 were GBP 1,429.236m. During 2024 the Syndicate recorded a gross release in prior-year claims estimates of GBP 78.675m (net release after reinsurance protection of GBP 15.9m). The release reflects favourable development on prior accident years together with the effect of reinsurance protection provided by the Enstar LPT covering 2019 and prior accident years, which limits net deterioration on those years.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding sourced from Balance Sheet (liabilities: Claims outstanding prior-year comparative). Prior-year development (gross) taken from 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' row in the claims reconciliation (gross = (78,675) GBP 000). A net release figure (GBP 15.9m) is also reported and is stated to be net of the Enstar LPT; gross and net figures both present. No LOB-specific prior-year reserve movement amounts are provided. Claims development triangle (gross) available and used as cross-check. Units in triangle are GBP 000.
